aurora.title: Board Accounts

card.kilterAuroraCopy: Used the old Kilter app built by Aurora? Import a JSON export, or email Aurora Climbing to request your data.
card.kilterNewCopy: Sign in with your Kilter username and password to pull your sends, attempts, ratings and circuits into Boardsesh.
card.notConnected: Not connected. Link your {{boardName}} account to bring your sends across, or import from a JSON export file.

unlinkConfirm.title: Remove account link
unlinkConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to unlink your {{boardName}} account?

status.duplicateAccountCircuits: Circuits aren't syncing: another Boardsesh account is connected to this board login, so playlist sync is paused for both of you. Your sends and ratings still come through.

linkDialog.title: Link {{boardName}} Account
linkDialog.description: Sign in the way you'd sign in to {{boardName}} itself — your {{boardName}} username, not your email. Your credentials are encrypted before they're stored.
linkDialog.linkSuccess: {{boardName}} linked. Your sends are on their way — most land within a few minutes.
linkDialog.accountAlreadyLinked: Another Boardsesh member already has this account linked. If it's yours, unlink it from their account first, then try again.

kilterLinkDialog.title: Sign in to Kilter
kilterLinkDialog.description: Enter your Kilter username and password. Your password is exchanged for a secure token and never stored. Your sends start arriving within minutes.
kilterLinkDialog.passwordHelp: Works with your existing Kilter login. Two-factor or social-login-only accounts can't sign in this way — use Import instead.

aurora.unlinkPartial: We disconnected on our side, but the Kilter app may still be signed in. Sign out of Kilter there too if you want to fully cut the link.

dialog.previewNote: Climbs will be matched by name. Any that can't be matched will be reported after import. Re-importing the same file will not create duplicates.

kilterEmail.subject: Kilterboard data
kilterEmail.body:
Hey there!

Ex-app user here. I was wondering if I could get a copy of my data so I can save my logbooks and other data for personal tracking records.

My username is {{name}}, and this should be under this email ({{email}}).

Thanks!

{{name}}

feedbackForm.bugPlaceholder: What were you doing? What did you expect vs see?
feedbackForm.sessionRecordingDescription: Help us fix your bug faster by turning on session recording and reproducing the bug. You can turn it off after.
feedbackForm.bluetoothBugDescription: Scans for nearby boards and sends us what they broadcast, so we can figure out why yours won't connect. No board is controlled — we just listen.
feedbackForm.contactConsentLabel: Can we contact you about this?
feedbackForm.contactConsentDescription: Lets us email you the issue link and follow up if we need more detail.

boardConfigMismatch.title: Board configuration doesn't match
boardConfigMismatch.skippedSpillToast_one: Skipped {{name}} — it's set for a different board
boardConfigMismatch.skippedSpillToast_other: Skipped {{count}} climbs set for a different board
boardConfigMismatch.mobileSwitchFailed: Couldn't switch to that board's config. Try Connect anyway.
boardConfigMismatch.mobileConnectAnywayWarning: Our records show this controller belongs to another board setup. Connecting anyway may light climbs incorrectly.

ble.differentBoardType: These look like different boards than your {{board}} setup.
ble.troubleshootTips: Make sure it's powered on and awake. Only one phone can connect to a board at a time, so disconnect other devices. Move closer, or toggle Bluetooth off and on.
ble.locationHintTitle: Android needs Location to see boards
ble.locationHintBody: On Android 12 and newer, Bluetooth scan results stay hidden until Location is allowed. Boardsesh doesn't use your location to find boards, and a coming update drops this requirement for good.
ble.locationHintGranted: Location allowed. Close this and connect again to see your board.
ble.locationServicesHintBody: On Android 11 and older, Bluetooth scan results stay hidden while Location is off, even with permission granted. Boardsesh doesn't track your location — it just needs the toggle on to see nearby boards.
ble.locationServicesHintEnabled: Location's on. Close this and connect again to see your board.
